content: Sentence embeddings were calculated by taking the mean of the embeddings of their tokens. The importance of testing a character level n-gram model like fastText lies in the agglutinative nature of the Arabic language. We trained a new fastText text classification model BIBREF30 on our dataset with vectors of 40 dimensions, 0.5 learning rate, 2$-$10 character n-grams as features, for 30 epochs. These hyper-parameters were tuned using a 5-fold cross-validated grid-search.
